memory_candidates.content: When a multi-phase documentation plan spreads a cross-reference across two later phases (e.g. phase N adds a pointer to a statement phase N+1 will write), it is safe to write the forward pointer in the earlier phase, since the document is only externally consistent once the whole plan lands and each phase is committed in the same run. Verify the pointer resolves once the target phase completes, rather than deferring the pointer itself.

Before parametrizing a pytest test over a grid a research report measured, run the exact grid manually first and record each verdict (including a timeout/inconclusive flag if the framework distinguishes one) rather than asserting the report's Scope Hypothesis blind. A report's prose can render a formula differently than the suite's own test bodies; take formula strings verbatim from the current test source, not from report prose.
